plan_title: Diretrizes para o Programa de Transformação do Brasil (TSE, 84 pages, 13 chapters)

policies.title: Keep the current fiscal framework
policies.description: Preserve the existing fiscal rule: primary spending grows below revenue growth, with primary-balance targets kept.

policies.title: End the 6x1 work schedule / 40-hour week
policies.description: Reduce the legal work week to 40 hours and end the six-days-on/one-off schedule, without salary reduction.

policies.title: Create a Ministry of Public Security
policies.description: Split public security from the Justice ministry into a dedicated ministry that coordinates with states and municipalities.
policies.title_pt: Criar o Ministério da Segurança Pública

policies.title: Financial offensive against criminal factions
policies.description: Expand money-laundering investigations and asset seizure against organized crime; body cameras for police; tighter arms and ammunition control.

policies.title: Reindustrialization with state credit
policies.description: Industrial policy with subsidized development-bank credit and public procurement for strategic sectors.

policies.title: Expand social protection and minimum-wage real gains
policies.description: Keep and expand cash-transfer programs and continue real annual increases of the minimum wage.
policies.title_pt: Ampliar proteção social e ganho real do salário mínimo

policies.title: Implement the consumption tax reform on schedule
policies.description: Roll out the already-approved dual VAT (CBS/IBS) from 2027 as legislated.
policies.title_pt: Implementar a reforma tributária no prazo

policies.title: Higher taxation of top incomes
policies.description: Minimum effective income tax on very high incomes and dividends to fund social spending.

policies.title: Zero illegal deforestation and ecological transition
policies.description: Stronger environmental enforcement in the Amazon and green-industry incentives.
policies.title_pt: Desmatamento ilegal zero e transição ecológica

policies.title: Invest in the Armed Forces and national sovereignty
policies.description: Raise defense investment and frame foreign policy around national sovereignty and trade diversification.
policies.title_pt: Investir nas Forças Armadas e na soberania

policies.title: Expand subsidized housing
policies.description: Grow the subsidized housing program for low-income families.

policies.title: Expand education programs
policies.description: Full-time schools, daycare construction and the high-school student savings incentive (Pé-de-Meia).

policies.title: Trade diversification and new trade agreements
policies.description: Pursue new trade agreements and diversify export markets away from dependence on any single partner.

policies.title: Strengthen the public health system (SUS)
policies.title_pt: Fortalecer o SUS: especialistas e Farmácia Popular
policies.description: 'Agora tem Especialistas' programme to cut waiting lists for exams and surgeries, and expanded free medicines and lab tests at Farmácia Popular.
